items.title: Global Connections
items.body: We excel at identifying and honing premier talent, meticulously crafted to meet the exacting demands of your digital product and service, ensuring flawless execution.

items.title: Remote first work
items.body: Our talent offers a perfect balance between productivity and a more affordable annual cost compared to others. In addition to not paying taxes, social security, etc... We take care of that so you pay less.

items.title: Flexible time off
items.body: We offer 40 productive hours weekly for your business, with daily updates. Enjoy 8 extra hours, called NS Time, for meals, training, and meetings. Our training keeps our team learning new skills to benefit your business.

sections.heading: **Life at Nicasource**
body: Behind every project, there’s a team that collaborates and enjoys the journey together. At Nicasource, it’s not just about writing code or delivering features—it’s about creating spaces where people connect, share moments, and celebrate along the way.

Growth here feels collective. Our culture blends professional excellence with real human connection: from stand-ups to milestones, from learning opportunities to small celebrations like this one. Every challenge becomes a chance to grow stronger as a team and deliver lasting impact.

sections.heading: The Way We Work Is The Way We Grow Together
sections.body: At Nicasource, collaboration is built on shared principles. They guide how we deliver, but also define what we expect from every teammate who joins us. We believe growth comes when both sides live by the same standards — shaping how we show up, how we work together, and how we succeed as a team.
